types.name: Simple interest basics
types.description: Uses SI = PRT/100 or amount = P + SI to find interest, principal, rate or time at simple interest, including ratios of interests and present worth of a sum due later.

types.name: Sum becomes n times at simple interest
types.description: A sum doubles, triples or becomes n times (or a fraction more) of itself in some years at simple interest, and the rate or the time to become another multiple is asked.

types.name: Changing rate or time in simple interest
types.description: The simple interest rate changes over different periods, or the same sum is kept at two rates or two times and the interests are compared.

types.name: Sum split into parts
types.description: A total sum is divided into parts lent at different rates or for different times (simple or compound), with total interest given or parts giving equal amounts, and a part is asked.

types.name: Instalments
types.description: A loan is repaid in equal or given yearly instalments at simple or compound interest and the instalment, the loan or the last payment is asked.

types.name: Compound interest basics
types.description: Asks for compound interest, amount, principal or rate compounded yearly with whole years, including growth of production or population at compound rate.

types.name: Half-yearly and quarterly compounding
types.description: Interest is compounded half-yearly, quarterly or every few months and the interest or amount is asked.

types.name: Compound interest for a fractional time
types.description: Compound interest compounded yearly for a time that is not a whole number of years, like 2 1/2 years.

types.name: Amounts after two different times
types.description: A sum amounts to A₁ in t₁ years and A₂ in t₂ years at compound interest, or the interest of consecutive years is compared, and the rate or principal is asked.

types.name: Sum becomes n times at compound interest
types.description: A sum becomes n times itself in some years at compound interest and the time to become another power of n is asked.

types.name: Difference of CI and SI
types.description: Gives or asks the difference between compound and simple interest on the same sum at the same rate for 2 or 3 years.
